stages.label: History
stages.text: 50-year-old manual worker, no prior shoulder symptoms, fell onto an outstretched arm two weeks ago and cannot lift the arm.

stages.label: Imaging report
stages.text: MRI: acute full-thickness supraspinatus and infraspinatus tear with minimal retraction and no fatty atrophy.

stages.label: Exam
stages.text: Marked weakness in elevation and external rotation; passive motion full.

guideline.note: Early repair is commonly recommended for an acute traumatic full-thickness tear in an active patient.

attending.note: Repair soon, before retraction and atrophy.
